result:
Round 107 passes. I ran every browser row that can run here in real Chromium, in fresh logged-out sessions at 1280×720 and 1440×900 where the task asks, so `browserVerified` and `realVerified` are both true. I found one new bug, C-R107-01. It was already there before this round and does not block it.

**What I measured in the browser (27 sessions):**
- **Held shortcuts:** holding Ctrl+L, Ctrl+E, Ctrl+Shift+L or Ctrl+C for 10+ auto-repeats now acts once and announces once.
  - Ctrl+L: the loop button switches off once and stays off. Ctrl+Z turns it back on, and one more separate Ctrl+L turns it off again with one new announcement.
  - Ctrl+E: the clip count goes 1 → 2 once and the "playhead outside the clip" text never appears.
  - Undo still repeats: a held Ctrl+Z with 2 repeats steps the clip from 0.300 back to 0.000.
- **Held Enter on buttons:**
  - ◀: the "no previous marker" text appears once, where B's probe before the fix saw it 6 times.
  - ▶: the playhead goes to the marker (4.974 s) and nothing is announced.
  - `+`: the name editor stays open, no marker is created, and typing `Intro` + Enter gives exactly one marker named Intro.
  - `მონიშვნა`: holding it produces exactly one announcement and sets the range to 2–4 s.
- **Time-0 refusal:** with Snap off, ← on a clip at 00:00.000 now says why nothing moved. A separate press, a hold with 31 repeats and a later press each add that text exactly once. The clip, the Undo label and the status element stay unchanged. The Snap-on text is byte-identical.
- **Regression rows:** the neighbour refusal, held Space and the blocked-drag hold pass. The status texts are identical to round 106.
- **Premium auth is not bypassed:** `/studio/middle-east` shows "Sign in required" with no workspace, and `/api/studio-token` returns 401. No page request went to protected endpoints and none carried an `Authorization` header. The fake-Bearer sub-check is BLOCKED because the backend isn't available in the cloud.
- **Real export:** I added three demo sounds, ran Fit and exported a WAV: 101.702 s, 48 kHz stereo 24-bit, no NaN samples. Its RMS and its 486 full-scale samples match round 98 to 1e-11, so nothing changed in the output.

**Offline checks:**
- Lines 1–705 of the test file are byte-identical to the snapshot, and the new tests use only exact matchers.
- I re-ran five of A's mutations with my own edits (h1, h5, h8, h10, h12). Each turned the expected tests red (HK1, HK5, HE3, NZ1–NZ3, NZ3 + SK7).
- The targeted run gives 69 files and 1152 tests, all passing.
- Doc 092 is correct.
- The source is untouched by me: HEAD is `35112cd`, `git status` shows exactly the 6 expected modified files, and the 536 frozen files match.

**Bug for B — C-R107-01 (Medium):** after a keyboard reset of Clip Gain to `0 dB`, the button disables itself and keyboard focus drops to the page. The next Enter then adds the last library sound as a new clip at the end of the project, and another Enter adds a third. The edit shows in the status line and can be undone. I couldn't run the pre-round code in the browser, so "already there before" is inferred from the diff: none of the code involved was changed this round.

**Not claimed / with a caveat:**
- **HE-CLIPGAIN-RESET passed only with a deviation.** As written it can't run, because `0 dB` is disabled on a fresh clip. With A's corrected setup (gain 1 dB first) it gives one announcement. Because the button disables after its first click, the browser can't prove the held-Enter guard on this button; only A's jsdom test HE4 and A's mutation h9 cover it.
- **B spec wording:** HE1's "repeated Space on ◀ is not prevented" can't hold, because the workspace already prevents Space on buttons. A's replacement assertion tests the intended property.
- **Gate rows:** I didn't run the full test suite, typecheck, build, Biome, `npm run verify` or the e2e smoke; those belong to the root gate.
- **First Ctrl+E attempt:** it was invalid because of my own recipe (clicking the clip moved the playhead). Its output was overwritten by the valid re-run.

**Notes for B:**
- When the time-0 refusal fires, an existing time range is kept. That follows the "writes nothing else" rule, so I recorded it as an observation, not a bug.
- The next B planning, on or after 2026-10-24, is the regression round.

Files are in `/home/runner/czaba-project/tmp/studio-real-loop/`:
- `c-round-107.md`
- `c-round-107.json`
- `c-round-107/` (tools, measurements and screenshots)
